title: Postmortem
description: A blameless review of one incident: what happened, why, and the action items that keep it from happening again. It lives in docs/postmortems/<id>.md and names the backfill Spec of the emergency change that repaired it.

title.description: One line naming what users saw, such as "Checkout returned 500 for 40 minutes".

severity.description: Incident severity, as the emergency block records it.

spec.description: The backfill Spec id of the emergency change that repaired the incident, when there was one. `aidd validate` warns when no Spec in the repository has that id.

owner_team.description: The team that owns the review and its action items.

status.description: draft: being written. in_review: the people involved are checking the timeline and the causes. published: agreed; its action items are tracked as work.
